chunks: Abu al-Hasan al-Ridha عليه السلام was asked about the grave of Fatimah عليها السلام, so he said:
"She was buried in her house, but when Banu Umayyah expanded the mosque, it became within the mosque."

key_terms.قَبْرِ: grave, the burial place being asked about

ai.seo_question: Where did Imam al-Ridha عليه السلام say Sayyidah Fatimah عليها السلام was buried?
ai.summary: This hadith reports Imam al-Ridha عليه السلام explaining that Fatimah عليها السلام was buried in her house. Later, when the Umayyads expanded the mosque, the location of her grave came to be included within the mosque area.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.685 - Abu Al-Hasan, Imam Ali ibn Musa Ar-Ridha (as) was asked about the grave of Sayyida Fatimah Al-Zahra {S.A}, and Imam (as) said:
"She was buried in her house, but when the Umayyads expanded the mosque, her grave became part of the mosque."
